data.auto_regenerate_pickup_code: Auto-regenerate pickup code when it expires

data_description.auto_regenerate_pickup_code: Off (default): when the pickup code expires, the sensors clear and you press the button (or call request_pickup_code) to get a fresh one. On: the integration requests a new code ~every 10 minutes, even if unused. Warning: the server may invalidate prior codes when new ones are issued, which can disrupt an in-progress pickup.
